newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SML takes US$12.1 mln gas carrier stake.
newsitem.headline: SML takes US$12.1 mln gas carrier stake.

text.p: Sembawang Maritime Ltd (SML) said on Tuesday it had invested US$12.1 million to buy a part share in a 35,000 cubic metre multi-purpose gas carrying vessel in its fourth co-ownership deal with Belgium's CMB Group.
The deal gives SML a 25.5 percent share in the US$47.5 million vessel due to be delivered in early May, the company said in a statement.

SML said finance for the investment would be raised through a combination of internal resources and borrowings and was not expected to have any material effect on earnings in the current financial year.
In a separate statement, SML said its joint venture unit formed with Mulpha International Berhad took delivery of a Singapore $7.0 million catamaran.
The catamaran was the seventh in a ten-vessel order for the joint venture ferry operation, Water Jet Angels Fast Ferry Corp which serves the Philippine archipelago of 7,000 islands.
